description: This file defines a Sequelize model named 'Cart', representing a shopping cart in a food delivery backend. It specifies the schema for the 'carts' table, including fields for 'id', 'user_id', and 'restaurant_id', along with their data types and constraints.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: A Sequelize model representing the shopping cart associated with a user, optionally tied to a specific restaurant.
